item.title: 🔵 Sponsored: The evolution of ASD's Essential Eight
item.description:
Why this matters: Potentially urgent issue — confirm whether your environment is exposed.
In this Risky Business sponsored interview Tom Uren talks to Airlock Digital’s CTO and CSO Peter Baussmann about how the Essential Eight is evolving into ASD’s Essentials framework. The pair discuss why the change was needed and how Essentials is a broader framework that is less prescriptive and requires more judgement.

Source: Risky Business News  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 5h

item.title: 🟠 Scans for Sshole Vulnerability (CVE-2026-123158), (Sun, Nov 8th)
item.description:
Why this matters: Potentially urgent issue — confirm whether your environment is exposed.

Our honeypots use "Cowrie" to collect SSH data. With the emergence of the "sshole" vulnerability last week, we are now seeing an increase in attempts to exploit the vulnerability. Our data is a bit limited in this respect. Our honeypots collect only the first 255 characters of SSH passwords. Longer passwords are highly unusual and not used for the usual password brute-forcing we observe.



Source: SANS Internet Storm Center  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 8h
